name: Bounded checkpoint and ordinary-post summaries for task ID batches
summary: One work summary task-ID batch and HTTP client transport return a bounded latest linked checkpoint, declared lane state, next action and open-item count plus latest ordinary post identity/time/author. Current project visibility and record filters apply; hidden and unknown tasks answer alike. At most 100 distinct IDs, no per-task transport reads or checkpoint bodies/provenance expansion. Existing work-owner attention and display share matching activity selection only within one request; authority remains fresh.
aliases: bulk latest checkpoint last post coordinator work owner latency
